item.title: Potential implementation of municipal accommodation tax back on Norfolk council meeting agenda
item.description: Norfolk councillors will take another look at the potential implementation of a municipal accommodation tax for overnight stays in the county. After a close vote at a meeting last month, council put the brakes on the creation of the four-per-cent tax until it received more information, particularly details about the creation of a short-term rental bylaw.
